title: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change
seo_title: Adolescence Class 7 Science Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Curiosity Chapter 6)
standard_text: Adolescence and puberty; changes in the body during adolescence such as growth in height and changes in voice; role of hormones; personal hygiene; nutrition, exercise and sleep for adolescents; emotional health; saying no to harmful substances (summary of NCERT Curiosity Chapter 6).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 7 Science worksheets for NCERT Curiosity Chapter 6: adolescence and puberty, growth spurts and voice changes, hormones, personal hygiene, healthy diet, exercise and sleep, and emotional health. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Adolescence is the bridge from childhood to adulthood.
key_sub: Hormones bring changes; everyone grows at their own pace.
body_html:
How to think about it

Adolescence is the stage between childhood and adulthood, roughly from 11 to 19 years. During puberty, hormones bring changes such as a growth spurt, changes in the voice and more active skin and sweat glands. These changes happen at different ages in different people, and that is normal.

Growing bodies need a balanced diet with protein, iron and calcium, regular exercise, enough sleep and good personal hygiene. Feelings may change quickly; talking to trusted adults helps. Say no to tobacco, alcohol and drugs.

Example

Why do pimples appear?

skin glands become more active

Answer: changes during puberty

Example

Which mineral prevents anaemia?

helps make blood

Answer: iron

Common mistakes

  • Thinking everyone should change at the same age.
  • Skipping meals during the growth spurt.
  • Keeping all worries secret.

faq.q: Why is hygiene important in adolescence?
faq.a: Sweat and skin glands become more active, so daily bathing and clean clothes keep the body healthy and fresh.

items.q: Why do adolescents need a balanced diet rich in protein, iron and calcium?

items.q: Why should adolescents say no to tobacco, alcohol and drugs?

items.q: Which of these is a healthy snack for a growing teenager?

items.q: What is the role of a school counsellor?

items.q: Which stage of life is the later years of adult life?

items.q: When is adolescence?

about 1 to 3 years, when a child learns to walk and talk

items.e: Bathe daily and wear clean clothes.

items.q: Which stage of life is about 11 to 19 years, between childhood and adulthood?
items.e: Adolescence: about 11 to 19 years, between childhood and adulthood.

items.q: Which of these is a change seen in both boys and girls during adolescence?

items.q: What is peer pressure?

items.q: Why is regular exercise good for adolescents?

items.q: Why is iron especially important in an adolescent's diet?

items.q: What is puberty?

items.q: What should an adolescent do if a friend offers tobacco or drugs?
